stories.title: Compare two loan offers side by side
stories.markdown:
# Compare two loan offers side by side

A borrower with more than one offer can put two side by side and see which costs less, per month and over the whole loan, before accepting one.

## What changes

- A new **Compare offers** page shows two offers in columns: lender, APR, term, monthly payment, fees and total cost over the term.
- The offer that costs less over its whole term is marked **Lower total cost**.
- **Change offer** above a column lists the borrower's other offers; picking one replaces that column.
- Each column has **Accept this offer**, which goes on to accepting it, as from the offers list.

Borrowers reach this page from the offers list, which is the Offers story.

## Acceptance criteria

- Monthly payment and total cost match the figures on each offer's own details page, to the cent.
- When both offers cost the same in total, neither is marked Lower total cost.
- Change offer lists every other offer the borrower has, and not the two on show.
- Accept this offer leads to the same Accept an offer step as the offers list does.
- On a phone, the two offers stack, with the lower total cost first.
- **R-k2p.** The cheaper offer is the one with the lower total cost over its term, not the lower monthly payment.

## Looks right in

Typical, Two offers, Same total cost and Long lender names, each as its approved screen.

## For developers

- New page `GET /offers/compare?a=:id&b=:id`, designed in `prelude/loan-offers/views/offers/compare.eta`.
- Change offer is `GET /offers/compare/choose?side=a|b`, in the drawer (`views/offers/_choose.eta`).
- Each offer gains `monthlyPayment` and `totalCost`, in the loan's currency.
- Test data: `prelude/loan-offers/states/` (`01-typical`, `04-two-offers`, `05-same-total`, `03-long-names`).
- `npm run check` compares every page in every state with `prelude/loan-offers/snapshots/`.

stories.title: Confirm the bank account before accepting an offer
stories.markdown:
# Confirm the bank account before accepting an offer

Before a borrower accepts an offer, they confirm the bank account the loan is paid into, so the money never goes to an account they've since closed.

## What changes

- **Accept this offer** now opens **Confirm your bank account**, showing the account on file (bank and last four digits) with **Use this account** and **Use a different account**.
- **Use a different account** asks for the routing number and account number, and checks them before going on.
- The offer's summary on the Accept step shows the monthly payment beside the APR.

## Acceptance criteria

- Nobody can accept an offer without confirming an account.
- A routing or account number that doesn't check out keeps what was typed and says which one is wrong.
- Closing the confirmation with **Not now** leaves the offer unaccepted.
- A borrower with no account on file goes straight to entering one.
- **R-v8d.** An offer is accepted only once the bank account it pays into is confirmed.
- Legal has signed off the wording of the confirmation (LEG-212).

## Looks right in

Typical and No account on file, each as its approved screen.

## For developers

- New dialog `GET /offers/:id/accept/account`, over Accept an offer (`prelude/loan-offers/views/offers/_account.eta`).
- New form `POST /offers/:id/accept/account`; it requires `routingNumber` and `accountNumber`.
- `POST /offers/:id/accept` now refuses an offer whose account isn't confirmed.
- Test data: `prelude/loan-offers/states/` (`01-typical`, `06-no-account`).
